sources.title: Mathematical Methods in Quantum Mechanics: With Applications to Schroedinger Operators
sources.author: Gerald Teschl
sources.version: Author-hosted first edition, Graduate Studies in Mathematics 99, 2009; PDF version February 12, 2009, 317 pages
sources.locators: Theorem 2.13, printed pages 71-72 (PDF indices 82-83); Theorem 6.24 (KLMN), printed page 150 (PDF index 161), with definition 6.39 on page 149
sources.reading_depth: Read the form definitions, full statements and displayed proofs of 2.13 and 6.24. Adjacent sandwiched-resolvent discussion inspected but not imported.
sources.matched_hypotheses: Dense closed semibounded reference form; actual Hermitian perturbation absolutely defined there with relative bound 28|tau|<1. These give a closed form and associated self-adjoint operator.
sources.gap: These theorems do not identify the perturbed global operator domain with D(H0). Response graph bounds require separate locality estimates.
sources.convention: Derive the I+K inverse and alternating Neumann sign directly from the workbench form.
sources.use: Established functional-analytic foundation; no threshold or evolved-interaction theorem imported.

inherited_primary_context: The frozen R1 primary-source map remains applicable for attribution of the interacting inverse; its later-stage hypotheses remain unproved.
